source.name: Alaska Department of Fish and Game - Results of the 2025 Permit Hunt Drawing (2026-2027 Alaska Drawing Permit Hunt Supplement, p. 20) and ADF&G hunt pages

notes: ADF&G 2025 drawing (application period Nov. 1 - Dec. 16, 2024; results announced February 2025; hunts in regulatory year 2025-26). Alaska's drawing is a pure random draw with no preference or bonus points: every valid application gets a random draw number per hunt and permits go to the lowest numbers. Residents and nonresidents are in ONE pool per hunt; ADF&G does not publish applicants by residency. tags = 'Permits Available' and applicants = 'Apps Received' from the table 'Results of the 2025 Permit Hunt Drawing' on page 20 of the 2026-2027 Alaska Drawing Permit Hunt Supplement. Apps Received counts application entries, not people (one person may enter the same hunt up to six times; a party application is one entry for two hunters). successPct = Permits Available / Apps Received x 100, rounded to 0.1 and capped at 100 (ADF&G prints the same ratio rounded to whole percent as '% Drawn'; every row agrees within 1 point). Null when nobody applied. Hunts open to both residencies carry the combined rate in BOTH residency stats, with tags/applicants null there (totals are on the row). Single-residency hunts have the other residency set to null. Some hunts cap nonresident permits (e.g. DS102 Tok Management Area: 10% to nonresidents), so the shared rate can overstate nonresident odds. Unit, area, legal animal and residency come from ADF&G's Regulatory Year 2026 hunt pages (index.cfm?adfg=huntingmaps.find_hunt&huntnum=<code>); eight 2025 hunts with no 2026 page (DG856, DI403, DM612, DS003, DS030, DS150, DS233, DS238) come from the 2025-2026 Drawing Permit Hunt Supplement. weapon: 'archery'/'muzzleloader' = certified-weapon-only hunts; 'any' = no weapon restriction listed; omitted where the restriction is mixed (shotgun/crossbow options, or bow-only in part of the area), see label. Bear hunts (DB, DL) are excluded. No deer drawing hunts appear in the 2025 results. Unit spelling matches the SubLabel field of ADF&G's GMUSubunits layer.
